summary_plain: Independent print-only inspection of four pages and twenty systems confirms 94 printed physical regions and the proposed frame. All crop boundaries retain the essential musical ink. Pickups, partial bars, four changes of key, section double barlines and the final barline were checked directly. All systems use treble clef above and bass clef below; no clef changes are printed. No repeats, endings, route marks or bars split across systems are printed. Geometry assistance contains duplicate stroke candidates and four false staff-end candidates after cautionary signatures; these do not change the proposed lock. Only the authorized request, hashed print inputs and proposed print-only frame/geometry inputs were used; no reader outputs, candidate transcription, repair findings or prior verifier verdicts were accessed.

irregular_checks.question_plain: What is the opening pickup capacity?
irregular_checks.answer_plain: Dotted eighth, sixteenth and eighth total three eighth-note units. Both staves agree.

irregular_checks.question_plain: Do the fermata region and returning pickup complement one full bar?
irregular_checks.answer_plain: Yes. The dotted half holds six eighth-note units; the following pickup holds three. The smaller lower-staff ascent is retained in full. The double barline is complete and has no repeat dots.

irregular_checks.question_plain: Do the fermata region and returning pickup complement one full bar?
irregular_checks.answer_plain: Yes. The dotted half holds six eighth-note units; the following pickup holds three. The smaller lower-staff ascent is retained in full. The double barline is complete and has no repeat dots.

irregular_checks.where: P057 followed by P058 in system 13
irregular_checks.question_plain: How do the short regions around the key change divide the metre?
irregular_checks.answer_plain: P057 contains a dotted half tied to a quarter and then a sixteenth on both staves: eight eighth-note units and one sixteenth-note unit. P058 is one sixteenth-note unit, completing nine eighth-note units together. The final flagged note is separate from the continuous closing double barline.

irregular_checks.question_plain: Is the key-signature area an additional region?
irregular_checks.answer_plain: No. A complete double barline closes P018 at crop x 1517. The cancellation and three sharps are cautionary; the remaining staff lines reach the system edge without an additional barline. P018 itself is a dotted half plus dotted quarter, a complete nine-eight bar.

irregular_checks.question_plain: Does the final region close completely?
irregular_checks.answer_plain: Yes. Dotted half and dotted quarter total nine eighth-note units. The thin and thick closing strokes form one final boundary, fully inside the crop.

irregular_checks.where: All four pages and all twenty systems
irregular_checks.question_plain: Are there later clef or metre changes, repeats, endings, route marks or bars split at system breaks?
irregular_checks.answer_plain: No. Each system prints treble clef above and bass clef below, without any mid-system or cautionary clef changes. Nine-eight remains in force. There are no repeat dots, ending brackets or route instructions. Every system has a closing barline; ties and slurs crossing a system break do not split a physical bar.

checklist.question: Do all staves, notes, rests, slurs and other musical marks fit completely inside the page?
On every full-page red crop rectangle, is all tempo text, dynamics, hairpins, slurs, stems, flags, pedal notation, octave lines and other musical ink inside the rectangle?
Do the blue lines match every printed barline, giving 94 printed regions?
Where red geometry and blue Prep boundaries differed, does the final frame follow the printed barlines rather than either proposal automatically?
Do the compact red labels state every visible repeat, ending, route mark, special barline, partial, meter/key change and clef change—and are all unlabeled blue regions truly normal?
Are all region labels outside the printed system, with no ending, repeat, clef, note or mark hidden?
Does the clef list state each opening clef and every visible clef change?
